steps.eval: setInterval(() => { const m = [...document.querySelectorAll('.cp-zone-marker')].find(e => e.textContent.includes('Senado Square')); if (m) m.id = 'senado-marker'; }, 500)

steps.wait_for_js: (() => { const m = document.body.innerText.match(/SIM CLOCK (\d\d:\d\d:\d\d)/); return m && m[1] >= '14:08:00'; })()
